messages.挑発値で攻撃を受け、味方の被弾と自分の失った体力で強くなる出血の人格。: A Bleed Identity that draws attacks through Aggro and grows stronger as allies are hit and he loses HP.
messages.挑発: S1「獲物追跡」・S2「銛穿ち」・守備「お返し」は使用時に次のターンの挑: **Aggro**: S1 Stalk Prey, S2 Snagharpoon, and the Defense skill Payback grant Aggro next turn on use.
messages.出血: S1は使用時に呼吸回数が増え、Ⅱコインで出血2を付与。S2は対象の出血3: **Bleed**: S1 increases Poise Count on use and inflicts 2 Bleed with Coin Ⅱ. S2 grants 1 Poise per 3 Bleed on the target and increases Bleed Count on Critical Hit. S3 Sever Knot inflicts more Bleed the lower his HP.
messages.S3: 嫉妬共鳴3以上でマッチ威力+1、嫉妬共鳴4以上・嫉妬完全共鳴6以上でコイ: **S3**: +1 Clash Power at 3 or more Envy Resonance, and Coin Power rises at 4 or more Envy Resonance and at 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance.
messages.バトルパッシブ「穿たれた刺青」(嫉妬×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分を含む味: **Combat passive — Mutilated Tattoos (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time an ally, including himself, takes damage, he gains 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up next turn (2 if the damaged ally is a Pequod member, up to 6/9). Damage rises with HP lost.
messages.集中戦闘では挑発値で攻撃を引き受け、被弾で攻撃・防御レベル増加を貯める。体力が減: In Focused Encounters, take attacks with Aggro and build Offense and Defense Level Up from hits. Bleed infliction and damage grow as his HP drops, so use S3 when his HP is low. Lining up Envy skills to build Resonance strengthens S3.
